The same words stay weak (below a quarter of max) after abstract or technical frames ('saved on a', 'shown in a', 'flows through a buffer', 'The server/current may'), after plain transitive or copular verbs ('saw a', 'bought a', 'is a'), after personal-pronoun subjects ('He may', 'We may'), with 'will', and in code.
